datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Lesotho to collect Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) data. The spatial classifications were aggregated by administrative area and scenario type, then compiled into geographic datasets (GeoJSON/KML format) for October-December 2020 medium-term projections.
